title: Fix Compose Algorithms Story Infinite Loading
description: Investigate and fix the compose algorithms Storybook loading forever. Resolve the preview startup/runtime failure causing 404 index.tsx and outdated optimized dependency 504 errors, extend existing tests only, verify runtime behavior, and close the ticket with the worked files.
summary: Stopped the compose algorithms Storybook stories from loading forever by replacing the unstable compose/ui and compose/js runtime path with a local algorithms Storybook shell and runtime-safe story data. Verified the Flatten story renders successfully in a headless browser. `npm test` for @compose/algorithms still fails because the repo-wide vitest target imports the broken consolidated elements/ui index bundle.
